messages:
marta: quick heads-up 1: i opened a PR to tighten up SOC2-friendly wording around audit log retention, legal holds, and exported redacted logs. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/341. can @legal and @kevin review the retention/legal-hold phrasing?

kevin: reading now. one immediate concern: we currently say 'audit events may be kept longer for legal reasons' which is vague. recommend a sentence like: 'Retention timers are suspended for records subject to an approved legal hold; otherwise records follow the configured TTL and automated redaction schedule.'

anna: that reads well. maybe use 'suspend retention' instead of 'suspend timers' to be clearer to non-engineers. and add a short list of examples when holds are applied (court order, internal investigation, regulatory request).

legal: +1 to the examples. also add this explicit audit-friendly line: 'Audit events will only be retained beyond configured TTLs when preservation is required by lawful process such as a court order or subpoena.' auditors have asked for that type of sentence before.

marta: thanks — i'll incorporate. also adding an "Audit export" snippet for users who need redacted copies (curl + node + py). draft below. feedback on redaction modes and expected response shape appreciated.

```bash
# request an async audit export. redaction=pii_removal strips common PII fields
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"range":{"from":"2025-06-01T00:00:00Z","to":"2025-07-01T00:00:00Z"},"redaction":"pii_removal","include_system":false}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/exports
```

```python
# python example using redwood client
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=os.getenv('API_KEY'))
job = c.audit.exports.create(from_='2025-06-01T00:00:00Z', to='2025-07-01T00:00:00Z', redaction='pii_removal')
print(job['job_id'], job['status'])
```

```js
// node example
const {Redwood} = require('@redwood/inference')
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.API_KEY })
const job = await client.audit.exports.create({ from: '2025-06-01T00:00:00Z', to: '2025-07-01T00:00:00Z', redaction: 'pii_removal' })
console.log(job.id, job.status)
```

kevin: looks good. please add an "expected response" snippet showing the async shape so integrators know what to poll for:

```json
{ "job_id": "exp_12345", "status": "queued", "download_url": null, "expires_at": null }
```

and a note: when status=="ready" download_url will contain a signed URL valid for 7 days by default. exports are asynchronous and may be delayed during high load; consider retry/backoff when polling. also mention exports are rate-limited per org.

marta: added expected response and a short paragraph about polling/backoff. i also documented that export artifacts are retained for 7 days unless the customer has an extended retention add-on.

docs-bot: i updated the PR description with the legal team's suggested sentence and added the three SDK snippets under "Audit export examples". CI checks queued.

anna: nit: in the SOC2 section we reference an "evidence pack" entry. can we pin the exact sentence in the evidence pack content so legal can pull it for audits? avoids drift.

legal: please do. i've approved the final wording for the SOC2-friendly sentence in the evidence pack. remember auditors prefer literal matches.

marta: saved the approved sentence verbatim into evidence/docs/evidence-pack.md and linked to it from the PR. merging after CI. thanks! :tada: 

kevin: one more security note for the docs team: when showing examples of redaction modes, include a short definition of each mode (summary vs pii_removal vs none) so customers pick the right level for compliance. also add a warning that redaction is best-effort and teams with regulated PII workloads should use Private deployment + KMS.

marta: good point — added a small section 'redaction modes and considerations' with short bullet definitions and the KMS/private deployment recommendation.

marta: filing a follow-up issue to cross-link the compliance playbook and the legal-hold request form from the customer support docs. issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/659

marta: merging now. closing thread.
